voice.description: Editorial, serious, warm. Financial Times × Bitcoin Magazine. Never hype, never crypto-bro, never marketing-speak.
do: Use Spanish and English interchangeably where appropriate. Both are first-class.
Treat the reader as an intelligent adult.
Write in the first person plural ('we') when speaking as the hosts.
Use editorial conventions: pull quotes, italics for emphasised single words, small caps for organisation names where supported.
avoid: 'To the moon', 'HODL', rocket emojis, or any price/trading reference.
Generic Web3 / crypto language. BBH is Bitcoin-only.
Excessive formatting (bold emphasis, long bullet lists, multiple exclamation points).
Claims about returns, forecasts, or what Bitcoin's price 'will' do.
Calling meetups 'events' in marketing copy — use 'meetups' or 'talks'.
signature_phrases: Solo Bitcoin. No price. No trading. No altcoins.
One talk a month. Zero interruptions.
Drinks on the terrace. Dinner after the talk.
A family first, a meetup second.
The Trojan horse at Passeig de Gràcia 19.

motifs.description: Visual and verbal motifs that recur across every surface.

motifs.name: Masthead
motifs.description: Top-bordered and bottom-ruled horizontal bar in uppercase sans — carries the brand name, location, date, and edition number. Evokes a newspaper masthead.

motifs.name: Editorial rule
motifs.description: A full-bleed 1–2px ink rule used to separate section introductions from content, like an editor's cut.

motifs.name: Paper grain
motifs.description: Every surface is textured. Mandatory 3-layer SVG turbulence: fine film grain (overlay) + medium grain (overlay) + coarse paper wrinkle (multiply), scaled 200/384/720px respectively.

motifs.name: Grayscale + 1px ink border
motifs.description: All photography. No exceptions. Filter: grayscale(100%) contrast(1.06). Border: 1px solid var(--bbh-ink).

motifs.name: Orange accent rule
motifs.description: A 3px × 56px horizontal block of Bitcoin Orange placed before headlines to mark 'BBH' content — never as a full rule, always a fragment.

motifs.name: Numbered editions
motifs.description: Every meetup is numbered. Use '№' (numero sign) followed by a Roman numeral for marketing, or Arabic for tables/archives. 'Meetup № XVI', '№ 15'.

motifs.name: Venn diagram
motifs.description: BBH's origin metaphor: the intersection of Bitcoin and mainstream Finance/Policy. Reused in the About page and available as a pen-and-ink illustration.

motifs.name: The Solo Bitcoin declaration
motifs.description: The opening line of every meetup. Always rendered as a blockquote with italics on 'Solo Bitcoin' in Bitcoin Orange.
